about.title: Head Gymnastics Coach
about.bio: I specialize in building gymnasts from the ground up — teaching safe progressions on bars, beam, floor, and vault while developing the strength, flexibility, and mental confidence that competition demands. My athletes grow as gymnasts and as individuals.

hero.headline: Perfect the Form. Stick the Landing.
hero.subline: Private gymnastics coaching — skill progressions, routine development, and competition prep for gymnasts at every level.

services.title: Skill Progressions
services.description: Structured, safety-first progressions on bars, beam, floor, and vault — building skills in the correct order for long-term development.

services.title: Routine Development
services.description: Choreography, connection bonus planning, and routine execution training for competitive gymnasts building toward meets.

services.title: Competition Prep
services.description: Pre-competition run-throughs, deduction minimization, and mental preparation strategies for meet-day performance.

faq.question: What age groups and levels do you train?
faq.answer: I work with gymnasts from age 4 through USAG Level 10. Beginners, recreational, and competitive gymnasts are all welcome.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at a local gymnastics facility with full equipment. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: Sessions run 60–75 minutes. Competitive gymnasts working multiple events may benefit from extended 90-minute sessions.

faq.question: Is this supplemental coaching or primary instruction?
faq.answer: Both — I work with gymnasts as their primary coach or as supplemental coaching alongside their club program.

faq.question: How do you approach skill safety?
faq.answer: Every skill is taught with proper progressions and appropriate spotting. I never rush skills — building them right the first time prevents injury and builds confidence.
